#include <stddef.h>
#if defined(__APPLE__)
#include <OpenGL/gl.h>
#include <OpenGL/glu.h>
#include <GLUT/glut.h>
#else
#define GL_GLEXT_PROTOTYPES
#include <GL/gl.h>
#include <GL/glext.h>
#include <GL/glu.h>
#include <GL/freeglut.h>
#endif
#include <math.h>
#include <stdlib.h>

#ifndef M_PI
#define M_PI 3.14159265358979323846
#endif

static float g_angle = 0.0f;
static int   g_rotating = 0;

--- gl_vector_helpers ---
/* C89 replacements for C99 compound GL literals. */

static GLfloat *repl_glfloat3(GLfloat a, GLfloat b, GLfloat c) {
  static GLfloat repl_glfloat3_buf[3];
  repl_glfloat3_buf[0] = a;
  repl_glfloat3_buf[1] = b;
  repl_glfloat3_buf[2] = c;
  return repl_glfloat3_buf;
}

static GLfloat *repl_glfloat4(GLfloat a, GLfloat b, GLfloat c, GLfloat d) {
  static GLfloat repl_glfloat4_buf[4];
  repl_glfloat4_buf[0] = a;
  repl_glfloat4_buf[1] = b;
  repl_glfloat4_buf[2] = c;
  repl_glfloat4_buf[3] = d;
  return repl_glfloat4_buf;
}
--- display_header ---
void display(void) {
  glLoadIdentity();
  glPushAttrib(GL_ALL_ATTRIB_BITS);
--- lights_pre_camera ---
--- camera ---
  glTranslatef(0.0000f, 0.0000f, -3.5000f);   // @camera dist
  glRotatef(0.0000f, 1.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f);   // @camera rx
  glRotatef(0.0000f, 0.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f);   // @camera ry
  glTranslatef(-1.0000f, -0.5000f, -0.0000f);   // @camera pan
--- header_post ---
  float A[16], B[16], C[16];
--- source ---
  // Quadratic Bezier control points A=(ax,ay), B=(bx,by), C=(cx,cy).
  // ax/ay/cy are intentionally left at their implicit 0 -> A=(0,0), C=(2,0).
  static float ax, ay, bx = 1, by = 1, cx = 2, cy;
  static float x, y; // bezier() output: the curve point at parameter u
  static float period = 5;
  static float x_a, x_b, y_a, y_b;
  // current progress
  static float t0;

  bezier(u) {
    x = pow(1-u, 2) * ax + 2 * (1-u)*u * bx + u*u * cx;
    y = pow(1-u, 2) * ay + 2 * (1-u)*u * by + u*u * cy;
  }

  glClearColor(0.05, 0.06, 0.08, 1);
  glClear(GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT | GL_DEPTH_BUFFER_BIT);
  glEnable(GL_DEPTH_TEST);
  glDisable(GL_LIGHTING);
  glDisable(GL_MULTISAMPLE);
  glEnable(GL_LINE_SMOOTH);
  glEnable(GL_POINT_SMOOTH);
  glEnable(GL_BLEND);
  glPointSize(8);
  glColor4f(1, 0.85, 0.15, 0.95);
  glLineWidth(1.3);
  t0 = (fmod(t, period)) / period;
  glBegin(GL_POINTS);
    glVertex2f(ax, ay);
    glVertex2f(bx, by);
    glVertex2f(cx, cy);
    bezier(t0);
    glColor3f(1, 0.35, 0.2);
    glVertex2f(x, y);
  glEnd();
  glColor4f(0.92, 0.95, 0.98, 0.95);
  glBegin(GL_LINE_STRIP);
    for(u, 0, 1, 0.01) {
      bezier(u);
      glVertex2f(x, y);
    }
  glEnd();
  glColor4f(0.55, 0.3, 1, 0.4);
  // De Casteljau level-1 points: lerp along each control leg (A->B and
  // B->C) by t0. The "Derived Line" between them (drawn below) is tangent
  // to the curve, and the curve point at t0 sits on it.
  x_a = ax*(1-t0) + bx*t0;
  y_a = ay*(1-t0) + by*t0;
  x_b = bx*(1-t0) + cx*t0;
  y_b = by*(1-t0) + cy*t0;
  glBegin(GL_POINTS);
    glVertex2f(x_a, y_a);
    glVertex2f(x_b, y_b);
  glEnd();
  glBegin(GL_LINES);
    // Guide Line 1
    glVertex2f(ax, ay);
    glVertex2f(bx, by);
    // Guide Line 2
    glVertex2f(bx, by);
    glVertex2f(cx, cy);
    // Derived Line
    glVertex2f(x_a, y_a);
    glVertex2f(x_b, y_b);
  glEnd();
--- render_state ---
  glEnable(GL_MULTISAMPLE);
  glDisable(GL_LINE_SMOOTH);
